$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Now Playing player settings; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: nowPlaying
lists.note: The Now Playing player (Austin's idea, Leo 2026-10-18): off by default since 2026-10-19 (Lawrence did not want the card in the sidebar); the user can turn it on.

rows.note: Off by default. Off: no Now Playing card in the sidebar; a tab playing sound shows only its speaker in the tab strip. The New Tab page's player is tabs.newTabNowPlaying.

help.text: A player for what is playing, at the bottom of the sidebar.

lists.name: newTab
lists.note: The New Tab page's Now Playing player (Leo 2026-10-19: "disableable"): on by default; its right-click menu's Hide Now Playing turns it off.

rows.name: newTab
rows.note: On by default (Leo 2026-10-19), apart from the sidebar card (sidebar.nowPlaying.enabled, off by default). Off: no player on the New Tab page and no space kept for it.

title.text: Show Now Playing on New Tab

help.text: A player for what is playing, on the New Tab page.
